title: Both-states control harness for every health and validation probe
question: Build the substrate that lets each probe declare a KNOWN-BROKEN fixture and a KNOWN-GOOD fixture, then runs both automatically and marks the probe UNTRUSTWORTHY if it returns the same verdict in both states. This is infrastructure for the probes, not the Phase-10 test corpus, which bucket B08 owns.

evidence.claim: A deliberately useless probe that always returns OK is marked UNTRUSTWORTHY by the harness.
A genuine probe that fires on BROKEN and is silent on the healthy payload is marked TRUSTED in the same run.

negative_controls.description: A probe whose known-broken fixture path is absent is UNTRUSTWORTHY with skipped=false, not omitted.
Reviewer-designed always-OK probe returns PASS and ignores fixtures; harness still marks it UNTRUSTWORTHY.
